title: Meet a Scientific Paper: Article Types and IMRAD
objective: Students learn the main parts of a biology research article and what each section does.
phrases: The discussion explains what the results mean.
outcomes: Identify title, abstract, introduction, methods, results, discussion.
Explain the purpose of each IMRAD section.
Preview a paper before reading every word.
activity: Paper map: students label the parts of a short article and write one function sentence for each part.
example: A DNA paper may use Methods to explain sample collection, PCR conditions, and how DNA bands were analyzed.
